top_choice_rationale: P001 (Drucker, Holst, Mojsov for GLP-1 physiology and its active form) rests on one independently confirmed physiological chain, from the incretin effect and proglucagon processing to the active peptide, its glucose-dependent actions and receptor biology. It is fully mature, with outcome-trial support in glycaemia, weight, and cardiovascular and renal disease. The three seats map onto three distinct discovery steps. The citation can be worded around physiology without adjudicating the Habener or Mojsov priority question. No award is a clearly worse outcome for a mature, well-supported discovery.
